quarterly_data.quarter: Anji Microelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results: revenue RMB 2,504,217,940.48, up 36.47% YoY (CMP slurries +32.06%, functional wet electronic chemicals +63.73%); net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 783,648,337.86 (+46.85%); net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 696,553,465.49 (+32.36%); R&D 17.76% of revenue. The company attributes revenue growth to wider market coverage, higher customer usage and the introduction of new products and new customers, and says several key products entered volume ramp in step with customers' capacity release. Non-recurring gains of RMB 8,709.49 ten-thousand came mainly from fair-value gains on financial investments and government projects passing acceptance.

quarterly_data.quarter: Anji Microelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 R&D spending RMB 444,701,341.42 (+33.64%), 17.76% of revenue (18.13% in 2024), none capitalised; R&D staff 409, 52.10% of 785 employees. Nine in-progress R&D programmes (copper, tungsten, ceria-based, dielectric, and silicon / new-material / new-process slurries, functional wet electronic chemicals, etchants, electroplating solutions and additives, high-end nano-abrasives) carry a planned total investment of RMB 160,000.00 ten-thousand, with RMB 44,174.60 ten-thousand invested in 2025. In the year it filed 106 invention patent applications and was granted 21; 308 granted invention patents at year-end.

quarterly_data.quarter: Anji Microelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Product progress in 2025 (annual report): IC damascene copper electroplating solutions and additives entered volume production with sales, while advanced-packaging tin-silver and TSV electroplating solutions and additives remained in development and validation on plan; a slurry using the company's self-made ceria abrasive was applied to oxide polishing for the first time and reached volume sales, and several products with self-made ceria abrasive passed customer qualification and are in volume supply; several tungsten slurries passed qualification at advanced nodes for memory and logic chips with sales ramping; metal-gate slurries in volume production at several customers; a silicon nitride slurry co-developed with a customer reached sales; a new silicon (substrate) slurry went online at a customer; advanced-node post-etch cleans and alkaline copper post-CMP cleans ramped quickly, with post-etch cleans expanding in overseas markets.

quarterly_data.quarter: Anji Microelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity (annual report): the manufacturing base of subsidiary Anji Electronic Materials in the electronic-chemicals zone of the Shanghai Chemical Industry Park completed structural topping-out, which the company says lays the base for medium- to long-term capacity expansion; capacity expansion at the Shanghai Jinqiao and Ningbo Beilun bases is proceeding, with several new production lines providing capacity for the next stage; customer delivery fulfilment rate was 100% in 2025. Inventory rose 69.92% to RMB 1,049,515,256.94, which the company attributes to higher safety stock to match sales growth, and operating cash flow fell 10.83% because it stocked up on some raw materials.

quarterly_data.quarter: Anji Microelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (annual report, company): deliver products whose performance, quality and cost meet or exceed customer expectations, aiming to be customers' first-choice partner; strengthen capabilities in key raw materials and key technologies, using AI tools to speed innovation and product development; achieve sustained steady growth through continued market-share gains at home and abroad and technology- and cost-driven opportunities; look for M&A growth in selected industries and technologies. Strategy: beyond expanding its existing production bases, the company says it will plan new production bases to meet the technology and volume needs of newly built fabs in China and abroad.
